sections.title: Exit readiness
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,ends_on,blocking_issues,unfinished_activities,ineligible_participants,fixes_unclosed,unassigned_activities from v_exit order by code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by programme,record

sections.title: Agreements and participation
sections.sql: select programme,participant,name,platform,eligible,pending_activities,last_active_on from v_cohort order by programme,participant

sections.title: Records to review
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by rule,record
sections.note: Record checks flag missing evidence. They are not a legal compliance determination.

sections.title: Open feedback
sections.sql: select programme,code,title,severity,status,owner from v_feedback where status not in ('closed','duplicate') order by programme,code

sections.title: Retest evidence
sections.sql: select programme,feedback,tester,build,outcome,due_on,current_build from v_retests order by programme,feedback
